chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: Let's take a look at this function.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: f of x is equal to x minus 1.5 squared plus 0.5.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: That function is a parabola that looks something like this.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: It's centered horizontally at 1.5, and

chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: its minima is here at 0.5.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: Now, the optimizer or the minimizer doesn't know that.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: We can tell it by looking at the equation, but

chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: the minimizer has to figure it out on its own.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: So let's suppose we tell it, hey, minimizer,

chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: why don't you start with a guess of 2.0 and see if you can figure out from there

chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: what it is.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: So the minimizer says, okay, I'll give it a go.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: And here's what it does.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: First thing it does is it checks the value at 2.0.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: It turns out that that's about 0.75.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: It then tests the value nearby, say here and here.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: And it finds out that, gee,

chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: this equation has a slope about like that at this point.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: Now it's trying to minimize, and so what it does is it marches downhill.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: It's called gradient descent, and it tries another value down along that slope.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: It gets a particular value here, tries another one, and so on.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: And eventually it narrows in, and it discovers that 1.5 is the value for x at the minima.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: And the value of y there is 0.5.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: Now the example I gave you for, you know, sort of marching down this gradient descent is one method.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: There are many variations on that method that different kinds of minimizers use.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: And SciPy, the library that we're using, has many of those options,

chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: and you can choose different ones according to your taste.

chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: We're going to stick with one particular approach through our examples here, but

chunks.title: What is an optimizer  Part 2
chunks.text: you ought to experiment and try some of the other ones as well.
